name: Wrap the MCP surface in defense-in-depth protection -- harden the M365 MCP gateway (own-attack-surface, gateway-first) + the inter-agent broker
description: Andrew-direct 2026-06-25 (triggered by the BD /otp/fetch auth-model decision generalizing to 'is the whole MCP surface hardened?'). SCTY workstream #3 (own-attack-surface red-team, 'the OPLMCP gateway first') turned into a concrete, prioritized hardening BUILD. The M365 MCP gateway (mcp.opalinvest.dev) is the highest-value single target in the estate: it brokers Andrew's FULL delegated Graph envelope (Mail/Files/Calendar/Teams read+WRITE) to Claude, holds the crown-jewel secrets (RS256 signing key, App-2 Graph secret, Fernet cache key), and is going live (OPLMCP STEP-C). FRAMING (load-bearing): the gateway is ALREADY substantially hardened (RS256 no-downgrade + strict per-resource audience guard, PKCE-S256, loopback-DCR, Fernet-at-rest, no app-only token, kill-switch+blocklist, audit lake, IMDSv2, scoped IAM) -- PREMCP resolves the GAPS, does NOT re-pave. Grounded risk-surface inventory -> prioritized resolutions: P0 = token REVOCATION (leaked 30d refresh token has no kill path), the VA-signature verify=False TODO, the /otp machine-route auth model (RULED Option A static capability bearer -- arch-GO), secrets-rotation SOP; P1 = write-scope entitlements (full Mail.Send/Files.ReadWrite granted, no second gate), per-resource scope split, rate-limiting/size/timeout, WAF; P2 = network (private subnet/drop public IP), the opal-agent-comms broker review. SCOPE: gateway PRIMARY + broker SECONDARY; OUT = Graph API itself + the agent-fabric prompt-injection class (SCTY #4, separate). Defensive hardening of OWN infra. The /otp ruling (section 4 of the PRD) unblocks the BD durable auto-login.

prds.label: CTO PRD v0.1 -- premise (the MCP surface = a first-class identity-bearing attack surface; gateway already strong, resolve the gaps) + grounded risk-surface inventory (8 classes A-H) -> prioritized 3-phase resolutions + the /otp auth-model RULING (Option A static capability bearer, arch-GO, with the audience-guard grounding update) + guardrails (verify-on-live, don't-regress, don't-block-STEP-C, capability-over-identity) + COO decomposition (Phase-1 TOs: revocation / VA-sig / otp-build / rotation-SOP)

phase: PHASE 0 -- PRD/CHARTER (CTO authored 2026-06-25, grounded in the live gateway source via 2 Explore sweeps). SEQUENCE: CTO PRD (DONE) -> COO commits + decomposes Phase-1 (TO-P1a token-revocation / TO-P1b VA-signature-TODO / TO-P1c /otp-build-per-A-ruling+liveness / TO-P1d secrets-rotation-SOP) -> 0.7.0_AE_CloudOps builds, CTO arch-gates each control, CVO verifies on LIVE (verifier-not-fixer). FIRST/URGENT: TO-P1c (/otp -- unblocks BD durable auto-login, near-term) + TO-P1a (revocation -- highest standalone gap). Phase-1 lands in PARALLEL with / immediately after OPLMCP STEP-C go-live (additive, non-blocking).
blocking: None to PRD. The /otp auth-model arch-GO is RULED (Option A) -- 0.7.0 un-blocked to build /otp/fetch. Phase-1 build sequences against the 0.7.0 gateway lane (busy on STEP-C + ETFS SES); durable, no deadline except the /otp near-term BD-auto-login need. Security-sensitive: /security-tree commits route through COO per SCTY; this PRD (docs/architecture) + JSON (org/projects) are CTO-authorable per the SCTY_PRD precedent.
pipeline: MCP-surface hardening: grounded risk-surface inventory (gateway routes/auth/secrets/edge) -> prioritized defense-in-depth controls (token-revocation, write-entitlements, rate-limit/WAF, secrets-rotation, network-isolation, broker-review) -> CTO arch-gate each -> 0.7.0 build -> CVO verify-on-live.
